title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2605.22511v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Outcome based reinforcement learning provides a simple and effective recipe for training search augmented reasoning agents. Recent work seeks further improvements through stronger external teachers, auxiliary process supervision, specialized reward shaping, and increasingly elaborate training pipelines. This raises a natural question: can agents continue improving by learning from their own successful experience? We present Search-E1, a simple self evolution framework that alternates vanilla GRPO with on policy self distillation (OPSD). After each GRPO round, Search-E1 mines sibling trajectories generated by the policy itself and exposes the search skeleton of an efficient successful trajectory, that is, the sequence of queries it issued, as privileged context. translated_title: Search-E1：自蒸馏驱动搜索增强推理的自我进化
translated_abstract: 基于结果的强化学习为训练搜索增强推理智能体提供了一种简单而有效的方案。近期研究通过更强的外部教师模型、辅助的过程监督、专门的奖励塑形以及日益复杂的训练流程来寻求进一步改进。这引出了一个自然的问题：智能体能否通过从自身的成功经验中学习而持续改进？我们提出了Search-E1，一个简单的自我进化框架，它在原始GRPO与在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）之间交替进行。在每轮GRPO之后，Search-E1从策略自身生成的同类轨迹中进行挖掘，并将一条高效成功轨迹的搜索骨架——即它所发出的查询序列——作为特权上下文呈现出来。随后，通过token级别的前向KL散度目标，将标准推理上下文下的策略与该特权上下文下策略自身的分布进行对齐。通过这种方式，策略……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Search-E1提出一个简单的自我进化框架，通过交替使用GRPO与在策略自蒸馏，将策略自身成功轨迹的搜索骨架作为特权上下文进行对齐，使搜索增强推理智能体无需外部教师即可从自身成功经验中持续自我改进。
en_tdlr: Search-E1 introduces a simple self-evolution framework that alternates vanilla GRPO with on-policy self-distillation, aligning the policy with its own distribution conditioned on the search skeleton of its own successful trajectories as privileged context, enabling search-augmented reasoning agents to continuously self-improve from their own successful experience without external teachers.
